mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT candidate.id AS user_id, candidate.display_name FROM sys_user candidate WHERE candidate.status = 'ENABLED' AND candidate.id <> #{currentReviewerId} AND ( ( #{sourceType} = 'FAMILY' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_parent_student parent_student WHERE parent_student.parent_user_id = candidate.id AND parent_student.student_id = #{studentId} AND parent_student.status = 'ACTIVE' AND parent_student.relation_role = 'PRIMARY_GUARDIAN' AND parent_student.primary_scope_key = 'PRIMARY' ) ) OR ( #{sourceType} = 'TEACHER' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_teacher_class teacher_class WHERE teacher_class.teacher_user_id = candidate.id AND teacher_class.class_organization_id = #{sourceOrganizationId} AND teacher_class.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ) OR ( #{sourceType} = 'ORGANIZATION' AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization_admin organization_admin JOIN sys_organization admin_root ON admin_root.id = organization_admin.organization_id JOIN sys_organization source_organization ON source_organization.id = #{sourceOrganizationId} WHERE organization_admin.user_id = candidate.id AND source_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(admin_root.organization_path, '%') ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization student_organization JOIN sys_organization student_scope ON student_scope.id = student_organization.organization_id JOIN sys_organization source_organization ON source_organization.id = #{sourceOrganizationId} JOIN edu_teacher_class teacher_class ON teacher_class.class_organization_id = student_organization.organization_id WHERE student_organization.student_id = #{studentId} AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND teacher_class.teacher_user_id = candidate.id AND teacher_class.status = 'ACTIVE' AND student_scope.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(source_organization.organization_path, '%') ) ) ) ) ORDER BY candidate.display_name, candidate.id
